Samuel Achterberg-Osei
Cloud Engineer | Azure Infrastructure & DevOps
[EMAIL] | [PHONE]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Azure infrastructure and DevOps engineer with hands-on experience designing and operating cloud environments, building Terraform-based infrastructure, and automating delivery with Azure DevOps. Delivered Azure landing-zone networking, CI/CD pipelines for 15 internal applications, and a 60-server VMware-to-Azure migration completed across six weekends without unplanned downtime. Brings operational experience with AKS, Linux and Windows servers, networking, and practical Microsoft 365 security configuration.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Azure IaaS, Azure Migrate, Azure Virtual Networks, Azure Firewall, Azure Private DNS, private endpoints, App Service, AKS
Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Terraform modules, infrastructure drift detection
CI/CD and containers: Azure DevOps Pipelines, YAML pipelines, Docker, Helm
Networking and security: Hub-spoke networking, VNet peering, site-to-site VPN, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, MFA, conditional access, mailbox auditing
Systems and scripting: Windows, Linux, VMware, PowerShell; Python (small scripts); Go (Terratest tests only)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Cloud Engineer (Contract) | Havenstad Logistics | 2025–Present
• Designed Azure hub-spoke landing-zone networking using Terraform, Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering across three subscriptions.
• Developed Terraform modules, added Terratest module tests to the Azure DevOps pipeline, and implemented a nightly infrastructure drift-detection job.
• Replaced manual deployments of 15 internal .NET and Node applications with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for build, test, and deployment to App Service or AKS.
• Increased deployment frequency from roughly monthly to several times per week for most applications.
• Operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools, and ingress; application manifests are owned by developers.

Freelance IT Support | 2022–2023
• Created a repeatable PowerShell script and checklist for small-business Microsoft 365 security baselines, enabling MFA, conditional access, mailbox auditing, and backups.

Systems Administrator | Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services | 2014–2020
• Administered around 250 Windows and Linux servers and supported staff across several municipal services.
• Planned and executed the lift-and-shift migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure using Azure Migrate; cutover was completed over six weekends without unplanned downtime.
• Used PowerShell to automate repetitive IT work.

CAREER BREAKS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Family caregiving | March 2020–August 2022
• Took a career break for full-time family caregiving; maintained Azure Administrator Associate knowledge and provided unpaid IT support to church and family.

Professional development | February 2024–February 2025
• Completed a part-time, online, English-language cloud bootcamp in December 2024.
• Studied Terraform and built a Proxmox homelab.

CERTIFICATIONS
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
Terraform Associate (2025)
docs.cover_letter:
Samuel Achterberg-Osei

Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity engagement. I bring hands-on Azure infrastructure and operations experience, with a strong match to the role’s infrastructure-as-code, networking, and platform-delivery work.

At Havenstad Logistics, I designed Azure hub-spoke landing-zone networking with Terraform, including Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints, and VNet peering across three subscriptions. I also added module tests and nightly drift detection, and replaced manual deployments of 15 internal .NET and Node applications with Azure DevOps pipelines. For most applications, deployment frequency increased from roughly monthly to several times per week.

Earlier, I planned and executed a 60-server VMware-to-Azure migration, completed over six weekends without unplanned downtime. In my current role I operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools, and ingress, while developers own the application manifests. My cloud delivery experience is Azure-focused, and I would bring this infrastructure, networking, and operational foundation to Corvale’s work connecting a new train fleet to cloud services.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience with Azure, Terraform, networking, and deployment automation could contribute to Corvale’s fleet connectivity platform.

Kind regards,
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
